name: Pocket Creator AI
tagline: Turn ideas into content worth sharing
description: Pocket Creator AI is an AI-powered content studio for creators, small businesses, entrepreneurs and social media managers. Generate original video scripts, stories, social posts, product promotions, captions and structured ebooks from your topic using Anna's language model through its bundled Creator AI tool. Choose a content format and tone, tailor video scripts by platform and duration, set a target audience, choose ebook length, add optional business details, create variations, and save or reopen drafts. If AI generation fails, the app reports the error instead of substituting a template. Review factual claims before publishing.
